text:
karen-support: heads up — multiple customers reporting 502/503 from hosted inference since 09:20 UTC. topline: surge in API 5xx, higher latency, and a couple of billing anomalies (negative or zero costs for some requests). started ~09:15 when we began a staged rollout for featuregate=route_v2.

mike-oncall: can you paste one customer request id + example error? any correlation with region or model?

karen-support: customer id svc-773, trace id trace=tx-0a3f. errors across us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Not limited to one model. Here's a curl I got from them:

```bash
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# -> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
# x-request-id: tx-0a3f
# body: {\"error\":\"gateway timeout\"}
```

aditya-rt: we flipped featuregate.route_v2 to 10% at 09:12, ramping to 30% at 09:18. route_v2 points to the new routing proxy that talks to the kernelpath-v2 pool.

sarah-sre: running quick query on ingress logs — I'm seeing a cluster of upstream 502s with backend error code 524 (origin timeout) and also a subset that show auth header truncated (len < 20). patchy traces: some requests never hit model hosts.

sam-platform: deploy-bot should have posted the rollout manifest. deploy-bot: can you show the rollout event?

deploy-bot: RELEASE 2026.03.18-rl-112 started staged traffic swap at 2026-03-18T09:12:40Z. route_v2 enabled via ops-config:gateway.selector=kernelpath-v2. Traffic weight: 10% -> 30% (auto). No schema validation errors recorded.

mike-oncall: possible hypotheses: 1) new proxy has a bug trimming Authorization header; 2) kernelpath-v2 hosts overload and timing out; 3) metrics pipeline missing some meter events leading to billing anomalies.

sarah-sre: checking kernelpath-v2 pod logs — I see frequent \"kvcache miss -> long stall\" and a handful of HTTP 502s logged by the proxy: 

```
2026-03-18T09:18:12Z proxy | upstream read timeout after 15s
2026-03-18T09:18:12Z proxy | raw-auth header len=16 truncated=true request_id=tx-0a3f
```

karen-support: customer reports also saw a spike in latency before the 502s (~2.4s -> 8s). They couldn't complete calls and billing shows a batch of meter events with 0 token usage and then a following correction.

aditya-rt: I can patch a quick fix to whitelist the auth header passthrough, but that won't help overloaded hosts. I'd recommend pausing the staged ramp and pinning traffic at 10% while we triage.

sam-platform: agree — pausing ramp now. I'm updating rollout to freeze at 10% and enabling fallback-route to kernelpath-v1 for requests that have auth header len < 20.

mike-oncall: can we reproduce internally? sarah, can you share a replay command I can run against the staging proxy with the customer's headers?

sarah-sre: replay prepared:

```bash
# replay request against staging-proxy
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $(cat sample_trunc_token)\" \n  -d '{"input":"test"}' \n  https://staging-proxy.internal.redwood/v1/generate
# returns 502 within 14s, proxy logs: upstream timeout
```

billing-bot: meter pipeline note: some ingress requests were accepted but routing returned 502 before meter enrichment; we wrote zero-cost events and then a downstream reconciler emitted correction events. That explains the negative/zero once-in-a-while anomalies.

karen-support: customers want ETA and repro steps. I'll tell them we've paused the ramp and are rolling forward a targeted rollback if we continue to see >5% error for 10m.

aditya-rt: I'm going to push a quick fix to the proxy to avoid trimming Authorization headers (small change). If error rate doesn't drop in 10m we'll do a full rollback of RELEASE 2026.03.18-rl-112.

sarah-sre: applying temporary iptables fix to route_v2 nodes to reduce kvcache pressure (evict prefetch backlog). Will report back in 5.

sam-platform: rollout paused at 10%. fallback-route for short-auth tokens enabled.

[5m later]
sarah-sre: error rate down from 12% -> 3.2% in the affected slice. latency back to baseline for most callers. I still see a few traces with backend 524; investigating host-level queueing.

mike-oncall: good. karen, tell customers: paused ramp, workaround in place, we saw auth header passthrough bug + overload on kernelpath-v2. Next steps: proxy patch + slow rollback plan if regression reappears.

karen-support: sending update now. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

[10m later]
aditya-rt: proxy patch deployed to route_v2 canaries. preliminary signals look clean. leaving a postmortem stub and will coordinate a full rollback window if needed.

sarah-sre: filing incident ticket with traces + sample truncated tokens + host logs. I'll attach a timeline.

mike-oncall: closing incident channel once metrics stable for 30m. I'll keep watching.

karen-support: closing loop with customers, they'll reopen if they see anything.

# end of thread
